summary: Flex Ltd., through wholly owned subsidiary ACS Acquisitions, Inc., signed a Stock Purchase Agreement on September 3, 2026 to acquire all equity of EPC Power Corp. from Charge Parent, LLC for $4.4 billion in cash, subject to customary adjustments. The deal uses a locked-box mechanism with enterprise value fixed as of June 30, 2026, and includes leakage protections. Flex guarantees purchaser obligations. The acquisition, expected to close Q4 2026, targets EPC Power to join Flex's Cloud and Power Infrastructure unit, which Flex plans to spin off in Q1 2027. HSR clearance required; termination rights exist after December 31, 2026, with two three-month extensions. Watch for antitrust review and spin-off integration details.
